1. Heard the learned Counsel for the applicant and the learned APP for the State.

2. This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R. No.129 of 2022, registered with Alibaug Police Station, Raigad, for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 272, 273, 188 read Naresh Pandurang Mhatre vs State Of Maharashtra on 13 July, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196890749/
1 with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 ("the Penal Code") and Section 26 (1), 26 (2)(ii), 26 (2)(iv), 26(3), 30(2)(a) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
3.

entities.text: Naresh Pandurang Mhatre vs State Of Maharashtra
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The matters in which an identical issue of the applicability of provisions of Section 328 of the Penal Code arises are posted for consideration on 5 th August, 2022.
In the 906-ABA-1891-22.DOC circumstances, list this matter on 5th August, 2022.

4. In the meanwhile, in the event of arrest of the applicant in C.R. No. 129 of 2022, registered with Alibag Police Station, Raigad, he be released on bail on furnishing a P. R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/-, with one or two sureties in the like amount.
5. The applicant shall cooperate with the investigation and report to the Investigating Officer as and when directed.
6. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and/or give threat or inducement to any of the prosecution witnesses.

7. List on 5th August, 2022.
[N. J. JAMADAR, J.]
